summary: Flat kerb opposite the car park, but homes sit 10-15 m behind.
reasons: Dwellings 10-11 m either side of section

best_section.where: Meiers Road west kerb, between the two house frontages beside the Indooroopilly Sciences Centre entrance

drivers.seclusion: Homes 10 m and 11 m either side of the section on this side; university buildings and car park across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane with parked cars nearby; room for a van is probable but bus and loading zones sit close by.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with bus stop, university entrance and car park traffic nearby.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb; signs nearby: bus zone, loading zone Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, mail zone and no stopping at the access road.

flags: Bus zone, loading zone and no-stopping signs within about 12 m of the kerb line
Busy road near a university entrance: noise
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy across the road to the east and north shades it in the morning.
cannot_judge: Which side of the road each sign applies to
